notes:
Quick CRM notes / call snippets:
- Use-case: SaaS KB for support portal (Tier 1 triage, auto-resolution suggestions). High fan-out: many concurrent users peak -> 800-1200 QPS on search endpoint.
- Index: target 400k-600k docs (articles, transcripts, product QAs). Avg doc length 600 tokens.
- Current stack: Elasticsearch for retrieval, custom LightGBM reranker on top. Looking to replace embeddings + rerank pipeline with hosted service.
- Latency target: p95 <= 300ms for end-to-end query (retrieve + embed + rerank). Prefer reranker latency <120ms.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; target cost/query ~ $0.0008-$0.003 (hosted) to be competitive with current infra.
- Model preferences: open embeddings (cost control) + ability to fall back to smaller reranker model for spikes. Need quantized/efficient variants.
- Routing/fallback: prefer auto-fallback to cached responses or smaller model if capacity constrained.
- "Customer quote": "We need predictable cost at scale — bursts kill our margins."
- Security: SAML SSO, org-wide audit logs, and EU data residency for a subset of records.
- POC success metrics: rebuild index in <=36h, p95 search end-to-end <300ms under 1k QPS, 10%+ relevance improvement over current reranker on internal eval set.
- Internal stakeholders: Head of Product (Ravi Patel), VP Eng (Maya Torres), Security (Darren Lee).
